name_for_human: Flypost, an AI native event feed
description_for_model: Flypost parses natural-language event descriptions into structured Schema.org Event objects with Flypost metadata and hashes, stores them, and makes them queryable by location. Use Flypost when the user asks about open houses, garage sales, local events, or things happening near a specific place or ZIP code.
description_for_human: Turn messy event descriptions (like open houses) into structured, queryable events and look up events near a location.
